pass_b_english: The list of bishoprics: An exposition by Epiphanius, Archbishop of Cyprus, of the precedence of patriarchs and metropolitans. The Patriarch of Rome, the Patriarch of Constantinople, the Patriarch of Alexandria, the Patriarch of Antioch, the Patriarch of Jerusalem. The calling of metropolitans: a) of the Province of Cappadocia, Caesarea; b) of the Province of Asia, Ephesus; c) of the Province of Europe, Heraclea; d) of the Province of Galatia, Ancyra; e) of the Province of Hellespont, Cyzicus; f) of the Province of Lydia, Sardis; g) of the Province of Bithynia, Nicomedia; h) of the same Province, Nicaea; i) of the same Province, Chalcedon; j) of the Province of Pamphylia, Side; k) of the Province of Armenia II, Sebastea; l) of the Province of Helenopontus, Amasia; m) of the Province of Armenia I, Melitene; n) of the Province of Cappadocia II, Tyana; o) of the Province of Paphlagonia, Gangra; p) of the Province of Honoriada, Claudiopolis; q) of the Province of Pontus, Neocaesarea; r) of the Province of Galatia II, Pisidia; s) of the Province of Lycia, Myra; t) of the Province of Caria, Stavroupolis; u) of the Province of Phrygia, Laodicea; v) of the Province of Phrygia Salutarica, Synada; w) of the Province of Lycaonia, Iconium; x) of the Province of Pisidia, Antioch; y) of the Province of Pamphylia, Perga; z) of the Province of Cappadocia II, Mopsuestia; aa) of the Province of Lazica, Phaselis; bb) of the Province of Thrace, Philippopolis; cc) of the Province of Europe, Trajanopolis; dd) of the Province of the Cyclades, Rhodes; ee) of the Province of Haemimontus, Adrianople; ff) of the same Province, Marcianopolis; gg) of the Province of Phrygia Cappadociana, Hierapolis. Concerning the autocephalous archbishops: a) of the Province of Mysia, Odyssos; b) of the Province of Scythia, Tomis; c) of the Province of Europe, Byzantium.

d. In the Province of Paphlagonia, Pompeiopolis. e. In the Province of Asia, Smyrna. In the Province of Isauria, Leontopolis. f. In the Province of Rhodope, Maronia. g. Concerning the overseeing bishops: Province of Cappadocia A, Metropolis of Caesarea, which has under it cities, namely bishoprics: namely, those of the Thermal Basilika, Nysis, Theodosiopolis of Armenia, the Kamulianoi, and Kikisou. Province of Asia, Metropolis of Ephesus, which has under it cities, namely bishoprics: twelve, such as those of Hypeton, Tralles, Magnesia, Meander, Elaia, Adramyttium, Assos, Gargarus, Mastoura, Kaloi, and Bryola.
